args.text:
name: venice-workflow-schedule-audit

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - venice/workflow-schedule-audit-v1
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/venice-workflow-schedule-audit.yml
      - agent/workflow_schedule_audit.py
      - agent/workflow_audit_requirements.txt
      - tests/test_workflow_schedule_audit.py
      - agent/verification/test_workflow_schedule_audit_acceptance.py

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  audit:
    name: workflow-schedule-audit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Install declared dependency
        run: |
          mkdir -p artifacts
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          python -m pip install -r agent/workflow_audit_requirements.txt
          python -c "import yaml; print('PyYAML', yaml.__version__)" | tee artifacts/pyyaml-version.log
          echo "head_sha=$GITHUB_SHA" | tee artifacts/source-identity.log

      - name: Run audit unit tests
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_workflow_schedule_audit.py -v 2>&1 | tee artifacts/unit-tests.log

      - name: Run unchanged owner acceptance suite
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          python -m unittest discover -s agent/verification -p test_workflow_schedule_audit_acceptance.py -v 2>&1 | tee artifacts/owner-acceptance.log

      - name: Audit checked-out SEC/options workflows
        run: |
          set +e
          python agent/workflow_schedule_audit.py --workflows .github/workflows --output artifacts/workflow_schedule_audit.json --source-commit "$GITHUB_SHA"
          code=$?
          set -e
          echo "audit_exit_code=$code" | tee artifacts/audit-exit-code.log
          python -c "import json,os;d=json.load(open('artifacts/workflow_schedule_audit.json'));assert d['schema_version']==1;assert d.get('source_commit')==os.environ['GITHUB_SHA'];print('status',d['status']);print('workflows',[r['path'] for r in d['workflows']]);print('errors',d['errors'])"

      - name: Upload audit evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: workflow-schedule-audit-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: artifacts/
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn
